posts.title: Generating True Random Numbers with a Geiger Counter and an ATtiny13 to serial port
posts.description: For most cases of random number generation, systems use a pseudo-random number generator (PRNG), that is an algorithm that generates numbers that "look" random. But for certain applications, where true randomness is required — as in cryptography or simulations — there’s a different approach: draw on a physical process that, by its nature, is unpredictable.
